payload.title: Admin UI for marketing automation (list/filter/export signups, enrollment and interaction detail, auth)
payload.description:
In-app admin UI for marketing: list/filter/export signups (WaitlistSignup/MarketingLead), view enrollment and step context, view MarketingInteraction history. Auth: only authenticated users with permission. See features/marketing_admin_ui.feature and docs/marketing-automation.md.
